easyPrerequisites: Rocket Volley must have valid targets.
description:
Cast Rocket Volley using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Maelstrom Artisan.
When Maelstrom Artisan enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
